theorems.name: Submission.p05_pie_identity_block_stabilization_a5b449214a
theorems.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n p t r : ℕ) (P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) R), (Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin (n + t - r) ↪ (Fin n ⊕ Fin t)) (cols : Fin (n + t - r) ↪ (Fin p ⊕ Fin t)), x = Matrix.det ((Matrix.fromBlocks P 0 0 (1 : Matrix (Fin t) (Fin t) R)).submatrix rows cols)}) = Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin (n - r) ↪ Fin n) (cols : Fin (n - r) ↪ Fin p), x = Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols)}
theorems.natural_summary: Combines accepted minor-extension, signed minor-reduction, and successive-minor containment results; identity minors handle n ≤ r.
